title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. translated_title: iPrefBench：一个以用户为中心的个性化移动设备使用智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 一个真正了解用户并能够代表用户行事的智能体，一直是AI助手领域长期以来的承诺。计算机使用智能体通过熟练地在各个应用中执行完全指定的任务，使这一承诺触手可及。然而，现实世界中的用户请求往往是不够明确的。为了针对特定用户正确行事，智能体必须从用户的活动历史中推断出部分缺失的信息，并就只有用户才能提供的信息进行询问，同时既不能做出无依据的假设，也不能用不必要的问题给用户造成负担。我们提出了iPrefBench，这是一个用于评估个人移动设备使用智能体“推断”（infer）与“询问”（ask）能力的基准测试，它在可执行的iOS环境中运行，并配有交互式的模拟用户。iPrefBench基于一个包含3,051个过往活动事件的一致性用户画像构建，涵盖跨26个应用的130个不够明确的用户任务。每个被省略的用户相关需求，按照设计，要么是可从历史中推断的，要么是需要向用户询问的……
tldr: iPrefBench是一个在可执行iOS环境中、借助交互式模拟用户来评估个性化移动使用智能体“从用户活动历史中推断缺失偏好”与“向用户询问必要信息”这两项关键能力的基准测试，其基于包含3,051个活动事件的用户画像，涵盖26个应用中的130个不明确任务。
en_tdlr: iPrefBench is a benchmark that evaluates personal mobile-use agents' abilities to infer missing user requirements from activity history and to ask the user for information that cannot be inferred, using an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user, a persona grounded in 3,051 past activity events, and 130 underspecified tasks across 26 apps.
